case_number: Civil Appeal Nos. 4178-4197 of 2022; Civil Appeal Nos. 4198-4217 of 2022; Civil Appeal No. 4218 of 2022; Civil Appeal No. 4219 of 2022

parties.respondent: Shakuntla Education and Welfare Society and others

court_name: Supreme Court of India, Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
summary: Batch of Civil Appeals challenging Allahabad High Court’s 28 May 2020 order allowing writ petitions by plot allottees challenging the demand of additional premium under GO 29 August 2014 and YEIDA Board Resolution dated 15 September 2014; High Court held GO and resolution violative of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and the Transfer of Property Act, 1882; issues include validity of 64.7% ‘no litigation incentive’, lump-sum payments, and allocation of additional amounts; leave granted in Supreme Court; judgment pending.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 17 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894
Section 5A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894
